scope.sampling: purposive recent official public RFQ cohort; 90-day issue-date window fixed before collection

roles.task: Acquire official public RFQ and linked award/order documents with hashes and access logs; stop at authentication or access denial
roles.output: raw source, source registry, inclusion/exclusion log

roles.task: Validate NSN, part/revision, condition, UI, QUP and conversion evidence from each historical order independently
roles.output: item equivalence and units matrix; null for unknowns

roles.task: Distinguish ceiling, obligation, CLIN price, invoice and payment; account for quantity, date, delivery, warranty, quality and nonrecurring costs
roles.output: eligibility.py inputs, term adjustments and reviewer evidence

roles.task: Independently inspect source pages; reconcile duplicates, split lines, revisions and modifications
Try to disprove each price lead using ordinary procurement explanations and missing data
roles.output: counterevidence, unresolved facts and rejection reasons

roles.task: Search DOJ, DoD/DLA OIG, GAO, agencies and court disclosures by verified identifiers and mechanism
roles.output: dated query log; bounded not-found status; known-case matches

roles.task: Approve evidence completeness and any next records/referral step
roles.output: review decision; no automated accusation or referral

price_gate: eligibility.py; verified award CLIN or invoice price plus complete unit/item/terms evidence; source history alone cannot pass

private_candidate_contract.public_output: methods, neutral source evidence, aggregate coverage and missing-data status
private_candidate_contract.public_identifiers_in_pilot: neutral faithful source transcription only, not candidate ranking

claim_ladder: reviewed referral; legal determination belongs to competent authority
required_negative_controls: No obligation divided by assumed quantity
No retail price without equivalent product and terms
No high price to fraud inference
No OIG/DOJ case repackaged as new
acceptance: All cohort documents accounted for including failed/empty records
All retained observations have primary source hash and page
All comparisons pass eligibility gate or are explicitly blocked
All candidate claims have alternative explanation and novelty review
No savings estimated without verified paid quantities and defensible counterfactual
A null finding completes the work package
stop_conditions: 30 RFQs processed or documented source-access limit reached
Missing historical units/terms cannot be resolved from authorized sources
Authentication, terms restrictions, restricted technical data or unavailable credentials encountered
No supported lead remains after counterevidence review

external_models.Claude: not invoked by this work package
external_models.Grok: not invoked by this work package
external_models.exchange: same source/evidence schema and critic gates; model identity and run provenance required

prohibited: sending allegations or agency messages without explicit authorization
claiming exhaustive coverage or undiscovered status from a limited search
